doctrine: Interest Media replaces Social Media as the operating paradigm. Algorithm delivers based on what users care about, not who they follow. Follower count is vanity; organic reach validates creative quality. Core workflow: produce 5-30+ variations organically, test across platforms, measure by view velocity (not likes), identify top 5%, amplify with 80% of paid budget. New budget model: 50% creative / 50% media (vs legacy 80/20 media/creative). Content volume beats polish; produce 4-15+ pieces daily via documentation + AI-driven batching (7x7 workflow). 80/20 split: 80% structural (core niche), 20% cultural (experimental/trending). Hook factory dominates first 1-3 seconds. Platform strategy evolves every 6 months; current underpriced attention: TikTok Shop, Whatnot, LinkedIn (B2B images), Snapchat Spotlight, YouTube Shorts, Substack. Live commerce (TikTok Shop affiliate, Whatnot) is 2009-era opportunity with face-to-face trust + internet reach. AI multiplies speed/volume, not replacement; voice-to-prompt context injection beats generic prompts. Personal brand is the final moat vs AI commoditization (name brand wins over generic). Monetization cascade: pebbles first (digital products $25-99, early-stage), then boulders (agency, high-ticket). Local AI agency playbook: $500/month social+ad management fulfilled in <10 min via AI tools. Operator playbook: audit current spend, learn AI tools (50-100 hrs non-negotiable), define 3 expertise areas + ICP, produce 7+ daily posts, test organic as R&D, amplify winners only, reactivate past clients weekly (unscalable scale). Key principle: algorithm is your market research; blame yourself not the platform; volume/speed/market-listening separates operators from everyone else.
